type.description: Whether the category is an app category or a game genre.

subcategory.description: The subcategory label, also its id in `/browse/?category=…&sub=…`.

names.description: Checked first: a regular expression matched case-insensitively against the display name and every package name. For names that say it all (`gcc-14-mips-linux-gnu` is a cross-compiler).

keys.description: freedesktop Main or Additional Categories (on any package) that mean this subcategory. Checked second.

sections.description: Distro sections that mean this subcategory, as `<source id>:<section>` globs (`ebuild-gentoo:dev-vcs`, `deb-*:vcs`, `rpm-opensuse:Productivity/Databases/*`). Checked third.

pattern.description: A JavaScript regular expression source string, matched case-insensitively against the display name, the short description and the LLM verdict's reason (for games also AUR keywords and the start of the long description). Checked fourth, in rule order.

weakKeys.description: freedesktop keys too broad to beat the text (`Viewer`, `Office`, `BoardGame`): checked fifth, after every rule's pattern.

weakSections.description: Distro sections too broad to beat the text (`deb-*:x11`, `deb-*:admin`): checked fifth, after every rule's pattern.

fallbackNames.description: Checked last, when nothing else matched: a regular expression on the display and package names (`python3-*` modules).

title: Enrich: subcategories
description: The second level of the category tree: for each category that has one, its subcategories and the signals that file an app there. A category missing here has no subcategories. Within a category the first rule that matches wins, in passes: `names`, then `keys`, then `sections`, then `pattern`, then `weakKeys`/`weakSections`, then `fallbackNames`/`fallbackSections`. An app nothing matches has no subcategory and is listed under its category only. See docs/categories.md.
